ground_friction.fix: randomize ground friction over the plausible range (0.4-1.2) in training, then retrain

added_base_mass_kg.fix: randomize added base mass over 0-3 kg in training, then retrain

motor_strength_scale.fix: randomize motor strength over 0.85-1.0 in training, then retrain

action_latency_ms.fix: randomize action latency over 0-30 ms in training, then retrain

observation_noise_scale.fix: train with observation noise up to 2x the task default, then retrain

grid.reading: last value = nominal + 1.5 x (edge - nominal); swept from nominal towards harder conditions; one shared nominal group
